acceptance.description: Validate inherited datatypeLibrary with pinned RELAX NG 2001 normative XLink escaping followed by RFC2396 (+ RFC2732) absolute fragment-free URI checks: accept http:ok, reject foo: and malformed percent escapes; preserve source provenance, escaped library identity, and empty-library support. Do not rely on System.Uri per-scheme normalization or bare relative-accepting XSD anyURI validation.

Use the pinned historical XML name productions for every RELAX NG schema NCName/QName position; reject U+0E35 as a start in element/attribute/name/ref/define and prefixed local names while preserving valid continuation and other historical boundaries.

Preserve the nine original Jing schema predicates (055,056,057,058,070,072,073,074,079); test independent positive/negative URI/name boundaries, inherited contexts, exact quotas and cancellation, then affected compiler/validator/API and normal/XML-only checks.

Record independent source review, bounded scan/accounting and ownership evidence plus relevant controlled allocation evidence; integrate and actually verify before corpus consumes repair. No oracle changes, public contract changes, or prior-evidence rewriting.
